summary: Validated new features: (a) GET /api/admin/proximo-codigo returns 401 without token and 200 with {codigo} pattern TL<year>NNNNBR when authenticated; (b) Nova entrega dialog auto-fetches and pre-fills form-codigo (verified TL20260001BR was fetched); (c) Save works without manual code entry, row appears in table and is retrievable via public /api/track/{codigo}; (d) Opening Nova entrega a 2nd time returned TL20260002BR (different, no collision); (e) Editar an existing entrega KEEPS the existing code (not overwritten by a newly fetched one); (f) Origem defaults DOURADOS/MS and uppercase-auto still work; (g) Movimentacao reflects on public tracking; (h) All 9 partner logos on /sobre load with naturalWidth>0 on desktop (1440x900) AND mobile (390x844) - Braspress, Jamef, RTE Rodonaves, Jadlog, Total Express, J&T Express, Loggi, Patrus Transportes, Alfa Transportes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py proximo_codigo: uses count_documents + while-loop to skip existing codes -> safe against seeded 3-digit codes (TL2026001BR) which don't match the 4-digit prefix pattern the generator emits (TL20260001BR).
EntregaDialogs.jsx useEffect only fetches /admin/proximo-codigo when !entrega (new create flow), preserving existing code on edit - verified.
Sobre.jsx PARCEIROS array has all 9 partners with valid emergentagent.net logo URLs; all load successfully.
Minor (informational): delete confirmation is an in-app AlertDialog modal, not window.confirm - Playwright dialog listener won't fire; use click on modal Excluir button. Not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Created TL20260001BR during test and deleted via API afterwards. Pre-existing TESTANDO123 was user-created and left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-code endpoint uses zero-padded 4-digit sequence (TL20260001BR) while seed data uses 3-digit (TL2026001BR); both coexist. Public tracking endpoint is /api/track/{codigo}, NOT /api/rastrear (that's a frontend route). Delete uses AlertDialog modal (click Excluir button, not native confirm).
